baseline: clean git archive of baselineCommit; no observer
candidate: sprint/ciclo-material-20261001; event capture sidecar/hooks outside serialized World, no new law
sourceFreeze: baseline SOURCE-MANIFEST.json67TS SHA256 verified; only src/world/index.ts,src/world/inventions.ts,src/world/spatial.ts and new src/world/material-observer.ts and static src/world/halo.ts inventory may differ; all other world/shared/server TS byte-identical to baseline. Record baseline,candidate,observer,runner,protocol SHA256 at start/end; any drift fails.
orderMeaning: ABBA then BAAB in every 50-step block; each arm is a fresh independent world and temporary Store; A1/A2 baseline, B1/B2 candidate+observer. Seed order rotates by round; no best-seed/round selection.
store: new Store in TMPDIR; save before tick1 to bind catalogue/context; identical persistence cadence from paramsOf in both arms; poststep ingest BEFORE store.save; observer ingest tick0 before initial save so pending dormant fixtures are visible; harness supplies Date.now=1000000000000+world.tick only during each synchronous Store.save to equalize host saved_at timestamps; restore Date.now immediately, no world/digest exclusions

observerSeam.semantics: ingest initial before Store.save attaches external WeakMap capture; poststep before save confirms captured events. Export non-destructive. No RNG/World mutation. Adapt only interface, not frozen analysis.

identity: unmodified digestoCanonico from each tree at 0/300/600/900/1200 and final; includes world+effective params with no exclusions, no version normalization; all four arms and all repeated rounds must agree; also hash all saved SQLite tables in stable logical order, including archive, at every checkpoint and final
costWindow: factory+initial ingest+file open and initial export measured and charged to each B total; blocks include stepWorld+event hooks, ingest, persistence, checkpoint exportRows+per-row JSON.stringify+64KiB-buffer file writes; final flush+close charged. No fsync/durable-IO claim: OS buffered writes. Digest computation, fixture creation, imports/assertions and audit-report generation outside timed blocks and reported separately; never use them as dilution denominators.

serialization.sink: exclusive newly created observer.jsonl file in each owned temporary directory; NDJSON metadata/coverage+structure+daily records; writeSync buffered chunks flushed each checkpoint, streaming SHA256, bytes/records, final close all timed. Final export object retained in report before temp cleanup. No fsync: buffered OS I/O only. No world/carta/network/public writes.

measurements: total ms/step, p50 and p95 per block
initial/final resource guards and each checkpoint
complete final observer export per B arm retained
audit report JSON/file/stdout timings separately reported, no attribution to simulation step
estimator: for each family and metric, log((B1+B2)/(A1+A2)) per seed-round including observer init/exports; average over all 6 seeds and both rounds, exponentiate minus1

bootstrap.hierarchy: resample 6 seeds with replacement, then 2 rounds with replacement within each sampled seed; whole ABBA/BAAB quartet retained; never treat blocks as independent seeds

gate.required: all identity/source/resource/fixture coverage checks PASS AND upper95CI(CPU overhead)<=0.01 AND upper95CI(wall overhead)<=0.01 in EACH family
gate.failure: NO CUMPLIDA; distinguish observed >1% from uncertainty overlapping 1%; noisy wall cannot be silently waived

fixture.fresh: unmodified createWorld(seed, V13params), synthetic defaults only
fixture.material-stressed: same fresh world plus blueprint-1 frame+roof+cistern+granary, eight resident structures and eight dormant structures in remote Chunk100,100; conditions cycle1,0.5,0.10001,0.05; food0.35/water0.3; builtAt0; ids1..16; first mortal neighbor thirst0.5/actiondrink/decisionAt1000 beside healthy cistern with ambient water0; all changes deterministic synthetic setup, same in A and B; S/I and memories untouched
requiredPerStressedSeedRoundArm: 8 synthetic resident and8 synthetic dormant structures at initialization
at least1 initial healthy structure transitions to condition<=0.1
active exposure>=1 structure-tick and dormant exposure>=1 structure-tick
B exports positive record/byte counts, brokenCrossings>=1, wearEvaluations>=1, activeExposureTicks>=1 and daily uses>=1
fixture.coverageFailure: NO CUMPLIDA; never replace a seed after looking at events; fixture setup assertions run before long gate

resources.guard: assert initial/end and each checkpoint; resource drift fails gate; no automatic priority repair that erases drift
resources.execution: single process, synchronous blocks, no competing gate workers

executionBarrier: parent authorizes real gate after protocol/runner review and observer integration; before barrier only syntax and runner selftest/fixture initialization, no real stepWorld trajectories
outputs: parent-selected new laboratory output JSON, raw rows retained; source/protocol hashes, every seed/round/arm/block/checkpoint, gates and limitations; write once with exclusive creation
limitations: 12 deterministic synthetic fixtures, not copies of live/public worlds
two rounds with six seed clusters can leave1% unresolved
same-process GC/interference may affect neighboring arms; balanced order/A-A diagnostic and confidence interval do not prove absence of all systematic bias
canonical world digest excludes persisted archives by design; logical SQLite table digest separately covers durable state
test/typecheck/full suite remain parent gates, never inferred from identity/cost result
activeExposureTicks is elapsed residency duration, not count of observer frames; dormant initial identities become archived after save and are tracked externally

supersedes.reason: Only extend source allowlist with src/world/halo.ts: T111 static outside-step inventory must register createMaterialObserver; inventory not imported by simulation runtime. v1/v2 preserved. All seeds/fixtures/statistics/thresholds unchanged.
